mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_number),0) FROM story_versions WHERE project_id=#{projectId}
SELECT FROM story_versions WHERE id=#{id} AND project_id=#{projectId}
SELECT FROM story_versions WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND status=#{status} ORDER BY version_number DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM story_versions WHERE project_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY version_number DESC LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO story_versions (row_version,created_at,updated_at,project_id,version_number,content,source_language,status,moderation_decision) VALUES (#{rowVersion},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt},#{projectId},#{versionNumber},#{content},#{sourceLanguage},#{status},#{moderationDecision}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE story_versions SET project_id=#{projectId},version_number=#{versionNumber},content=#{content},source_language=#{sourceLanguage},status=#{status},moderation_decision=#{moderationDecision},updated_at=#{updatedAt},row_version=row_version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
